subject: Security posture - Private VPC, SOC 2 status, and SSQ initiation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@acme.com>; Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security posture - Private VPC, SOC 2 status, and SSQ initiation

Hi Alice / Samir -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap:
- Desired deployment: Private VPC (VPC peering or PrivateLink) with data residency in us-west-2.
- Compliance: You asked about Redwood's SOC 2 status (in-scope controls for availability, confidentiality), GDPR data processing agreements, and potential HIPAA support for PHI.
- SSQ: You'd like to kick off an initial vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) and have a technical deployment diagram for internal review.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I'll share a high-level VPC deployment diagram and a SOC 2 one-pager. (ETA: tomorrow.)
2) If you can send over the SSQ PDF (or a link), we'll start populating it; Marissa will own security responses.
3) Laura can produce a concise diagram showing network isolation, no-internet air-gapped option, and service account boundaries.
4) We can schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security team next week to walk the diagram and SSQ answers.

Action items: 
- Alice: share SSQ + preferred timeline for questionnaire (Procurement joined for timelines).
- Marissa: will draft SOC 2 summary and enumerate HIPAA coverage/limitations.
- Laura: will prepare VPC diagram with air-gapped option.

Attachments for reference: none yet - will attach SOC2 summary and diagram in follow-up.

Thanks - talk soon.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Marissa / Laura - forwarding Acme's SSQ and their preferred timeline (5 business days). Can you please: 

- Marissa: pull together a SOC 2 summary (one-pager) that calls out which control categories are in-scope, where Redwood stores logs/audit trails, and our approach to GDPR/HIPAA. Note any limitations (e.g., certified third-party processors, customer responsibilities).
- Laura: produce a concise VPC/deployment diagram (redwood_vpc_diagram.png) showing:
  * Private VPC architecture (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink options)
  * Network isolation zones and allowed egress points
  * Optional air-gapped topology for on-prem or co-lo deployment (high-level only)

I can own the SSQ responses for the first pass and then loop in you both for technical Qs. ETA for deliverables: EOD Apr 17 if feasible.

Thanks - Marcus

Marcus / team -

Thanks for the heads up. Quick status: 
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security + Availability) 2027 audit; I'll attach the one-page summary. Any HIPAA scope is customer-specific - we support PHI when customers sign a BAA and configure Private deployments; I'll call out the controls we recommend for PHI (encryption at rest/in transit, strict IAM, logging retention).
- GDPR: we have DPA template and controls for data subject rights; will include the DPA link in our response.
- SSQ: I started filling the SSQ and left technical flags for Laura on network topology. I've attached the partially-populated SSQ (acme_ssq_draft-populated.pdf).

Laura - can you attach redwood_vpc_diagram.png (high-level) and include an optional air-gapped note. If you can get both files by EOD, Marcus can send the completed packet to Acme and request the follow-up call.

Attachments referenced: soc2-summary.pdf, acme_ssq_draft-populated.pdf, (Laura: redwood_vpc_diagram.png pending)

I'll mark items that need legal sign-off (DPA/BAA) and route as needed.

- Marissa
